name: Preferred Plastics Inc.
old_description: At Preferred Plastics, Inc. we provide a vast array of performance plastic and metal products to a variety of markets including construction, agricultural, industrial, automotive, and oilfield. PPI operates out of their 15,000 sq. ft. facility in Shiner, TX where they offer everything from milling and turning to welding and fabricating operations in house.
about:
Preferred Plastics Inc. operates a 15,000-square-foot facility in Shiner, Texas, supplying performance plastic and metal products to construction, agricultural, industrial, automotive, and oilfield markets. The company draws on over 30 years of combined industry experience among its staff and maintains long-standing vendor relationships for high-grade materials.

In-house capabilities include CNC milling, CNC turning, plastic and metal welding, fabrication, and plating, allowing the shop to produce welded plastic assemblies, plated and welded metal assemblies, and custom-designed components. The facility stocks more than 200 material grades and offers same-day shipping on stocked items, supporting both one-off prototypes and production runs.

Customers span heavy equipment, oilfield services, agricultural machinery, automotive suppliers, and general industrial manufacturers. The company emphasizes transparent supply-chain communication, helping clients avoid material shortages and maintain production schedules.

Preferred Plastics differentiates itself through bespoke service, cutting-edge equipment, and a commitment to accessibility—expediting orders to meet urgent timelines while providing material certifications and design collaboration from concept through installation.
